data_quality.impact: Trainerize records 34 non-test profiles with sex missing, 7 as male and 3 as other; these 44 profiles contain 1,118 tracked programmed workouts
data_quality.treatment: The owner reports that non-female labels reflect onboarding errors, but the audit does not infer or overwrite sex. Outcomes remain restricted to 529 profiles explicitly recorded as female until each exception is business-verified; the 26,304-workout all-account total is labelled operational only

data_quality.impact: Workout summaries exist for more former members than detailed set-level results
data_quality.treatment: Report coverage by status; do not generalise detailed outcomes to all former members

data_quality.impact: Members who train and log more are more likely to appear at later horizons
data_quality.treatment: Use paired samples and show n for every horizon and movement

data_quality.impact: Most outcomes are best training performances, not scheduled reassessments
data_quality.treatment: Label all results as training-log proxies; V2 must standardise tests

data_quality.impact: Loaded lifts use Epley estimates from 1-12 rep sets
data_quality.treatment: Retain raw weight and reps; do not present estimates as measured 1RM

data_quality.impact: Historical entries may mean total load or per-hand load
data_quality.treatment: Include only explicit 60-second targets and treat load interpretation as provisional

data_quality.impact: Relative standards require bodyweight within 45 days
data_quality.treatment: Leave ratios and standards unavailable when no nearby bodyweight exists

data_quality.impact: Different exercise names and equipment are not normally interchangeable
data_quality.treatment: Keep exact names separate except for the coach-confirmed Nexus, Barbell Front Squat and Barbell Back Squat aliases

data_quality.impact: The same Nexus squat was unintentionally recorded under three Trainerize exercise names
data_quality.treatment: Combine all three names into one canonical Nexus Point Squat outcome and one progression stage

data_quality.impact: Goblet and Nexus squat loads are not directly comparable
data_quality.treatment: Measure Goblet-to-Nexus stage transitions separately from canonical Nexus load improvement

data_quality.impact: Bodyweight-only entries may be stored as 0kg
data_quality.treatment: Retain 0kg rows but require positive baseline for percentage-change calculations

data_quality.impact: A statistical candidate is not automatically a publishable story
data_quality.treatment: Coach validation plus explicit member consent required

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: The accessible Trainerize account contains 529 accounts explicitly recorded as female.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Another 44 non-test accounts are male, other or have no sex recorded and are excluded from women's outcome analysis.

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Women have completed more than 25,000 tracked workouts in the accessible Trainerize history.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Confirmed-female accounts only; accessible history runs from 2023-09-11 to 2026-07-21. All-account operational total is 26,304.

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: The accessible Trainerize account contains 26,304 tracked programmed workouts across all non-test client profiles.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Includes 44 profiles not currently recorded as female: 34 have no sex value, 7 are recorded male and 3 are recorded other. The business owner reports these are onboarding classifications requiring review; do not describe the total as women's data until verified.

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: The dataset contains 24,227 distinct days on which a woman completed at least one tracked workout.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Two workouts completed by one participant on the same date count as one participant-day.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with at least one tracked workout
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: The accessible history includes completed training for 484 women.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Counts accounts explicitly recorded as female and excludes test accounts.

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: The audit recovered more than 22,000 detailed workout records for women.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Detailed API coverage is incomplete for former members; do not call this the total number of workouts completed.

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: The women's audit contains more than 500,000 recorded exercise results.
marketing_evidence.caveat: A result row is not always equivalent to one completed set; use 'recorded exercise results', not 'sets'.

marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Use internally to describe the distribution; milestone counts are clearer for public marketing.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Median is among women with at least one tracked workout, not every account or member ever sold.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with at least 6 months between first and last tracked workout
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Use as evidence of longitudinal depth, not as a retention rate.
marketing_evidence.caveat: A calendar span does not prove uninterrupted membership or regular weekly attendance.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with at least 12 months between first and last tracked workout
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Use as evidence of longitudinal depth, not as a retention rate.
marketing_evidence.caveat: A calendar span does not prove uninterrupted membership or regular weekly attendance.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with at least 24 months between first and last tracked workout
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Use as evidence that the database contains multi-year histories.
marketing_evidence.caveat: A calendar span does not prove uninterrupted membership or regular weekly attendance.

marketing_evidence.claim_status: Requires coach validation and member consent
marketing_evidence.caveat: Candidates are algorithmic screening flags, not verified transformations or causal claims.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with material improvement in at least 3 canonical movements
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Internal evidence for case review; validate each exercise history before publishing.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Material means at least 20% and 5 kg improvement in comparable estimated strength scores.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women advancing at least 2 mapped relative-strength standards
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Internal candidate list for standards-based success stories.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Requires nearby bodyweight and is unavailable for many follow-up results.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with clean observed Goblet-to-Nexus progression
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Internal evidence that the observed squat history began with Goblet Squat and later reached Nexus Point Squat.
marketing_evidence.claim_status: Requires coach validation before public use
marketing_evidence.caveat: Counts an exercise-stage transition, not a directly comparable kilogram improvement; accessible history may still omit older training.

marketing_evidence.metric: Women with any observed Goblet-then-Nexus sequence
marketing_evidence.recommended_wording: Use as a programming-pattern signal, not as a progression result.
marketing_evidence.caveat: Some women had a higher-stage squat recorded before Goblet because accessible history begins mid-journey or programming cycles revisit earlier movements.
